data.name: Key West Tour with Snorkel Boat from Miami
data.headline: Full-day Miami to Key West trip with a 3-hour snorkel boat tour, basic snorkel gear, drinks after snorkeling and free time to explore Key West.
data.description: Leave the driving to the professionals and enjoy a full-day Miami to Key West adventure that highlights coastal vistas and the iconic Seven Mile Bridge along the Overseas Highway. After a scenic ride south toward the Caribbean, spend the afternoon in vibrant Key West with time to wander Mallory Square, snap a photo at the Southernmost Point buoy, or savor authentic Key lime pie. The experience combines sightseeing, snorkeling, and independent exploration for a sun-drenched tropical escape.

highlight_box.title: from Miami: Key West Snorkel Tour
highlight_box.description: Explore the Florida Keys in one day and snorkel the warm waters

data.highlights:
* Visit Key West from Miami in one day
* Spot marine life in their natural habitat
* Snorkel the turquoise waters of the Florida Keys with basic snorkel gear included
* Soak in the sun on the boat deck or enjoy a swim in the warm ocean
* Enjoy free time to explore Key West
data.itinerary:
1. Ca. 6.30AM bus departure from select Miami meeting points
2. Ca. 11.30AM arrival in Key West
3. Ca. 3 hours snorkel tour by boat
4. Ca. 2 hours free time to explore Key West on your own
5. Ca. 5.30PM bus departure back to Miami
6. Ca. 9.00 PM arrival in Miami depending on traffic
